title: Queensland minimum housing standards
description: A walk-through of the minimum housing standards every Queensland rental must meet when the tenant moves in and throughout the tenancy, and how repairs are treated. Summarised from RTA pages.

items.title: Weatherproof and structurally sound: roof and windows keep rain out; walls, ceilings, decks and stairs are safe
Fixtures, fittings and appliances in good repair and not likely to cause injury
Working locks or latches on every external door and on windows reachable without a ladder
Free of vermin, damp and mould
Curtains or blinds in bedrooms and other rooms where privacy is expected
Adequate plumbing and drainage with hot and cold drinkable water
Private bathroom and a flushable toilet connected to sewer, septic or another system
A working cook-top if there is a kitchen
Laundry taps and plumbing if laundry facilities are provided
For a body corporate property, check which repairs are the body corporate's
Treat repairs needed to meet the standards, and other emergency repairs, as urgent
Make sure the tenant can reach you or the nominated repairer
